Confidence is the DESK's odds on his view, not his. CONFIRMED = the victim's own statement, an 8-K Item 1.05, a bank-regulator notice, or a state attorney-general breach notice. Off-wave incidents do NOT count (River Financial June ransomware CYB-INC-015 and TruStage since 7/11 CYB-INC-017 are excluded by date and vector). BASE RATE: named US bank victims via the wave vector appeared in 1 of 5 past waves (MOVEit, ~117 US banks mostly via vendors); 0 of 5 produced a run, failure or material loss. Desk sets 15%, below the 20% base, because PHP2Shell's bank exposure is the web layer, not cores (DEWEY legacy study), its attack complexity is rated HIGH, and victims seldom name the CVE (the tie-to-vector leg is strict). Kept above 10% for pre-disclosure exploitation and the low-footprint finding (KB-CYP-012). A version keyed to actual money lost would sit below 5% and was not registered. NEGATIVE-RESOLUTION RULE: a MISS needs a dated search inside 2027-01-24..2027-01-31 of EDGAR Item 1.05, state AG breach portals (CA, WA, ME, TX, VT), and the named vendors' newsrooms. Draft shown to Will said "roughly 20-25%"; lowered after adding the tie-to-vector leg. Marker to watch (WALTER 046, context only): the OCC's silence on who pays for agent-initiated transfers.
